name: Custom Order Maid 3D 2
original_name: カスタムオーダーメイド3D2
source:
Empire Club. The most luxurious bar that ladies and gentlemen come and gather.
The beautiful maids who worked there danced and talked with the customers to amuse them.

One day, the protagonist was told to meet his uncle.
His uncle told him he had newly opened a future-next generation Empire Club which was customizable and filled with new possibilities.
Unexpectedly, his uncle generously handed over the ownership of Empire Club… However, Empire Club was secretly in huge debt.
Although he cursed his uncle for fleeing outside of the country neglecting Empire Club as it was, he had no choice but to run the place. Not only he had to save the club from debt, there were so many outrageous problems. It was obvious that it wouldn’t be easy to solve everything.
In front of the protagonist who was totally at a loss, three maids appeared. They were the last few maids who remained working at Empire Club.
“Maria Seido” who is innocent and cheerful.
“Mafuyu Himuro” with serious and loyal personality.
“Risa Takizawa” a dignified, mature woman.
Starting with these three, the protagonist and maids cooperate to rebuild the future-next generation Empire club.

[From the [url=http://com3d2.world/r18/story.html]official website[/url]]

Tricked into taking over a debt-ridden Club by your uncle, it is up to you to decide where this will lead you. With three Maids in tow, you will promote and improve the Club in various ways while turning them into Idols. There are so many decision to make but all shall lead to building your own little paradise. Whether it is through being surrounded by an exclusive harem or other debauchery for there anything goes, if you let it be.


Custom Order Maid 3D 2 is a Visual Novel and Simulation Game which is set in a so-called Empire Club which is part of system which involves private high class clubs where the "Maids" (attire entirely optional) entertain customers in various ways. In which one is up to the "Master" (you) of the Empire Club to decide and the options have visibly been increased from past iterations.

While previously Maids acted as hostesses and Dancers when set as Private Maid or as Prostitute when set as Free one, the new generation of Empire Clubs is supposed to provide many other services through new facilities. These include but are not limited to Cafés, Restaurants and Bars as well as Hotels, Casinos and Massage Parlors.

Apart from working or learning skills for Night Service, Maids can be trained in various disciplines to attract customers through a daily scheduling system and can be visited or supervised.

Maids do now even become Idols which is center of this story. In an optional Rhythm Game, Maids not only dance but also sing alone or together to promote their club.

Everything is up to the master to decide, including which personality and appearance a Maid will have as well as how far and in which way the relationship develops through select-able events. "NTR" can be completely blocked.


Custom Order Maid 3D 2 is the upgraded version of Custom Maid 3D 2. With the exception of story and systems featured in expansions like the Empire League, VR Vacation and alike, everything else is either already there, improved or can be imported from the predecessor. 

Constantly being developed since CM3D2, the content can be increased vastly for a price. Making the predecessor having one of if not the longest script size for a video game (06/2017: 20 MiB). While featuring only 3 Personality types without any additions, the number can be increased to 16 currently. Other additions include more customization options, night skills, dances, events and new systems like marriage which come with a high amount of new events.

The It's a Night Magic Version removes all options, customization and otherwise as well as events related to sex. Developed in the Unity Engine, modding is easily done, allowed and has spread.
translation:
帝国俱乐部。名媛淑女聚集的最豪华的酒吧。
在那里工作的美丽女仆与顾客跳舞、交谈以逗他们开心。

有一天，主角被告知去见他的叔叔。
他的叔叔告诉他，他新开了一家未来的下一代帝国俱乐部，它是可定制的，充满了新的可能性。
没想到，叔叔竟然慷慨地交出了帝国俱乐部的所有权……然而，帝国俱乐部却背负着巨额债务。
尽管他咒骂叔叔逃到国外而忽略了帝国俱乐部的现状，但他别无选择，只能经营这个地方。他不仅要让俱乐部摆脱债务，还要解决很多令人发指的问题。显然，要解决所有问题并不容易。
茫然不知所措的主角面前，出现了三名女仆。她们是留在帝国俱乐部的最后几名女仆。
天真开朗的“玛丽亚·圣堂”。
性格认真而忠诚的“冰室真冬”。
“泷泽理沙”是一位端庄、成熟的女性。
从这三人开始，主角和女仆们合作重建未来——下一代帝国俱乐部。

[摘自[url=http://com3d2.world/r18/story.html]官网[/url]]

被你的叔叔欺骗接管了一家负债累累的俱乐部，这将由你来决定这将把你引向何方。带领三名女仆，以各种方式宣传和改善俱乐部，同时将她们变成偶像。有很多决定要做，但所有决定都会导致建立你自己的小天堂。无论是被专属后宫包围还是其他放荡的事情，只要你顺其自然，一切都会发生。


Custom Order Maid 3D 2是一款视觉小说和模拟游戏，以所谓的帝国俱乐部为背景，该俱乐部是涉及私人高级俱乐部的系统的一部分，其中“女佣”（完全可选的服装）以各种方式招待顾客。其中一个由帝国俱乐部的“主人”（你）来决定，并且选项比过去的版本明显增加了。

以前，女仆在设置为私人女佣时充当女主人和舞者，在设置为免费时充当妓女，而新一代帝国俱乐部应该通过新设施提供许多其他服务。其中包括但不限于咖啡馆、餐厅和酒吧以及酒店、赌场和按摩院。

除了夜间服务的工作或学习技能外，女佣还可以接受各种学科的培训，通过每日调度系统吸引顾客，并可以接受拜访或监督。

女仆现在甚至成为了偶像，这是这个故事的中心。在可选的节奏游戏中，女仆们不仅跳舞，还单独或一起唱歌来宣传她们的俱乐部。

一切都由主人决定，包括女仆的性格和外表，以及通过可选事件发展关系的程度和方式。《NTR》可以被彻底屏蔽。


《Custom Order Maid 3D 2》是《Custom Maid 3D 2》的升级版。除了《帝国联盟》、《VR假期》等扩展包中的故事和系统外，其他所有内容要么已经存在，要么经过改进，要么可以从前身导入。

自CM3D2以来不断开发，内容可以以一定的价格大幅增加。使前身成为视频游戏中最长的脚本大小之一（06/2017：20 MiB）。虽然只有3种性格类型，没有任何添加，但目前数量可以增加到16种。其他新增内容包括更多的定制选项、夜间技能、舞蹈、活动以及婚姻等新系统，其中包含大量新活动。

《It's a Night Magic》版本删除了所有选项、自定义以及其他与性有关的事件。模组是在Unity引擎中开发的，很容易完成、被允许并且已经传播开来。
